title: It Sounds Like Marketing. It's Operations.
spoken_text: You can build a service that gets a small hotel's returning guests to book direct, instead of paying a booking site to meet them again. It sounds like marketing. The work is operations. At a twenty room inn, the person who would write the thank you is the one checking in a guest and finding a plumber. The direct path is not a system, it is a list of small jobs, and the list belongs to nobody. The drafting got cheap. A language model writes the message, an automation tool schedules it. The judgment did not: who gets one, and what you tell the owner. So the qualification is not hotel marketing. It is owning a list of small recurring jobs in a business you do not own. Rates and revenue management stay outside.
